title: Across International
content: Across International is a U.S. laboratory equipment manufacturer supplying furnaces, vacuum ovens, cold traps, evaporators, and related heat-treatment systems used in advanced materials processing. These tools are relevant to aerogel R&D and pilot work where controlled drying, thermal treatment, and laboratory-scale process development are important. Across International is a practical Equipment Materials entry for technical teams seeking accessible lab infrastructure for materials workflows.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
